# Known govulncheck findings accepted as unfixable, reviewed 2026-09-10.
# See docs/DEPENDENCIES.md "known-unfixable govulncheck findings" for the
# full writeup of why each entry here has no available fix.
#
# Format: one OSV ID per line, "#" starts a comment, blank lines ignored.
# CI (security-go job in .github/workflows/ci.yaml) fails if govulncheck
# reports a *reachable* finding whose ID is not listed here — so adding a
# line here is a deliberate, reviewed risk acceptance, not a silence-all.

# Moby AuthZ plugin bypass with oversized request bodies (github.com/docker/docker).
# Fixed in: N/A even at latest (v28.5.2, checked 2026-09-10). Bug lives in dockerd's
# server-side plugin/AuthZ code; lokinode never runs dockerd. Pulled in only because
# flnd's lncfg package imports docker/docker/api/types/* struct types for config
# parsing (daemon/config.go:7).
GO-2026-4887

# Moby off-by-one error in plugin privilege validation (github.com/docker/docker).
# Same root cause and same "Fixed in: N/A" status as GO-2026-4887 above.
GO-2026-4883

# SQL injection via placeholder confusion with dollar-quoted string literals
# (github.com/jackc/pgx/v4). Fixed in: N/A (pgx v4 is EOL upstream; only pgx v5,
# already patched, gets fixes). `go mod why github.com/jackc/pgx/v4/stdlib` shows
# it's pulled in by flnd's own optional Postgres channel-DB backend
# (flnd/kvdb/sqlbase), not by lokinode. lokinode's db/db.go only ever opens
# gorm.io/driver/sqlite; the pgx/v4 stdlib driver's init() registers with
# database/sql but is never selected at runtime.
GO-2026-5004

# Denial of service in github.com/jackc/pgproto3/v2. Fixed in: N/A. Same
# unreachable-at-runtime path as GO-2026-5004 above (pgproto3 is pgx v4's wire
# protocol layer).
GO-2026-4518
